metric.name: Windows Peak Working Set
metric.definition: Peak resident working set (RAM-resident pages) of the measured node.exe process, polled while running and read once more after exit; the maximum sample is reported.
caveats: NOT Linux Maximum RSS and NOT Private Bytes / Commit Charge.
Includes shared pages; excludes pages paged out to disk.
Working-set trimming by the OS can lower the observed value.
Worker threads share the process working set; child processes would not.
All M3 comparisons use this single metric, so the comparison is internally consistent.

method.launcher: node.exe launched directly (no npx/cmd shim), so the measured process IS snarkjs
method.timing: Stopwatch around Process.Start -> WaitForExit (wall clock, includes startup)
method.logs: stdout/stderr captured to results/raw/m3_logs/*.log with [t=...ms] prefixes
